about: Hardcore route rules for tools/guide_draft.py --hardcore (docs/HARDCORE.md). Quest IDs are from the data pack; every rule names where it comes from and how sure that source is. A skip becomes '#skipquest <id> >> <reason>'; a note becomes a '.note' after the quest's '.accept'. Corrected from play (the contributors' deaths) over time. skip_zones: every quest of such a zone is left out of every route (a battleground is not leveling content): the Route Planner reads it; the drafter drafts zones by name and never meets them.

rules.name: Skull Rock
rules.reason: HARDCORE: cave with respawning enemies and a hard-hitting boss; kills a large share of players
rules.source: Blizzard forums, 'Advice on dangerous Horde quests to avoid in HC + SF' (several posters); dotesports top-10 hardcore quests to avoid

rules.name: Strength and Mercy
rules.text: VERIFY(beta): the Bear Form trial; the data only says to kill Ur'endra (near 54,65). Go in at full health with your buffs up and leave if it goes badly: the Tauren Bear Form test (Lunaclaw) kills careless players.
rules.source: the data pack (objective: kill NPC 258443 Ur'endra); docs/HARDCORE.md for the Tauren test; not seen in game

rules.name: Moonglade
rules.text: Moonglade is a long way from here. VERIFY(beta): cast Teleport: Moonglade (Classic's druid trainer teaches it at level 10; where Forever teaches it is unconfirmed). The way back is the hearthstone or a flight master (the client lists Horde flight nodes at Moonglade).
rules.source: the earlier drafted Skyborne Druid chapters (the Moonglade .todo steps the planner's install does not keep); docs/HARDCORE.md; the client's flight nodes in the data pack's maps

rules.name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
rules.text: VERIFY(beta): the three relics lie in the Stormrage Barrow Dens, east Moonglade (the data puts Fang near 72,66, Claw near 75,67 and Silent Shadow near 74,65). Fan guides say the spirits there attack on sight and the relics are party loot; a statue at the door gives a stealth blessing. Go in at full health and leave if hurt.
rules.source: docs/CLASS-QUESTS.md (worstguidesever.com and foreverchanges.pro, beta descriptions); the relics' positions are in the data pack

rules.name: Bloodfury Trinkets
rules.text: Elites roam among these harpies: Bloodfury Ripper (elite, near 31,62) and Sister Riven (rare elite, near 30,69). Kill only the ordinary harpies and keep away from those two.
rules.source: the data pack (NPC ranks and positions: 12579 and 5930)

rules.source: the data pack (item Raptor Head's drop sources; NPC 5842 Takk the Leaper has the rank rare elite)
